packageRules.description: Confluent Cloud's Python UDF runtime supports Python 3.10-3.11 only (requires-python in the UDF pyproject.toml files).
apache-flink is pinned by Confluent Cloud's Python UDF runtime, not by us (see 05-confluent-cloud/common/udf/pyproject.toml).
Jackson must stay on the line of Confluent's UDF runtime classpath: patch releases only (see common/udf-java/pom.xml).
flink-table-api-java is provided by Confluent Cloud's Flink 1.20 runtime: patch releases only.
Keep the Java UDF poms in step with each other.
